importModal.title: Import
importModal.dropzoneHtml: Drop a JSON file here or click to choose a file.
importModal.corsHelpHtml: Your browser will only allow MetroViz to read JSON from another site if that server sends appropriate CORS headers (for example Access-Control-Allow-Origin) that include this app’s origin. Hosting you control (e.g. GitHub Pages, raw files on the same domain, object storage with CORS rules) can work; many generic “paste” or file hosts block cross-origin requests, so the load may fail with a network error. If that happens, download the file and use the dropzone above, or host the JSON where you can set CORS.

js.savedSuccess:
"{{name}}" has been saved to Nextcloud Files.

The file lives in the /MetroViz folder and can be opened, shared, or versioned from any device through Nextcloud.
js.shareUnavailable: Compression is not available. Sharing is not possible right now.
js.shareNoData: No roadmap data yet. Add content or load JSON first.
js.shareLinkCopied:
The URL was copied to your clipboard.

The link is not just a pointer to MetroViz—it embeds your entire roadmap as compressed JSON, plus collapsed-zone state and the selected language. Opening the link loads the same map.

The URL can get very long. For sensitive content, share only over trusted channels.
